資料：
[1] <20260316_Wells_Fargo_MSFT_MSFT-_Agentic_Adoption_Hinges_on_Security-_E7_SKU_Presen.txt>
New SKU will be generally available on May 1, 2026.
3. M365 Copilot Wave 3 released, built in "close collaboration" with Anthropic's Cowork.
 
 
Expect E7 bundle upsells drive M365 Copilot, Agent 365 adoption; price hikes timely:
New Agent 365 offer brings agent registry/agent ID (in Entra), observability, risk signals, 
etc.—all important prerequisites for agentic adoption. Similar to M365 Copilot, see Agent 
365 adoption as unlikely standalone (via $30/mo, $15/mo SKUs) and instead expect 
both see accelerated adoption via E7 SKU. Note: recent M365 price hikes already force 
enterprise negotiations in 2H26, creating NT adoption catalyst.
[2] <Microsoft_Corp_Earnings_Call_2026128_RT000000003094331726.pdf.txt>
In security, we added a dozen new and
updated security Copilot agents across Defender, Entra, Intune, and Purview. For example, Icertis'
SOC team used security Copilot agent to reduce manual triage time by 75%, which is a real
game changer in an industry facing a severe talent shortage.
To make it easier for security teams to onboard, we are rolling out Security Copilot to all our E5
customers, and our security solutions are also becoming essential to manage organizations' AI
deployments. 24 billion Copilot interactions were audited by Purview this quarter, up 9x year-
over-year. Finally, I want to talk about two additional high-impact agentic experiences. First, in
healthcare, Dragon Copilot is the leader in its category, helping over 100,000 medical providers
automate their workflows.
點解 security 對 agentic adoption 同 E7 bundle 咁關鍵？

text:
Security 對 agentic adoption 同 E7 bundle 關鍵，原因如下：  
1. **Agent 365 嘅 prerequisites**：新 Agent 365 提供 agent registry/agent ID（係 Entra 入面）、observability、risk signals 等，這些均為 agentic adoption 嘅重要預先條件【KB:20260316_Wells_Fargo_MSFT_MSFT-_Agentic_Adoption_Hinges_on_Security-_E7_SKU_Presen.txt】。  
2. **Agentic adoption 唔 likely standalone**：M365 Copilot 同 Agent 365 類似，唔太可能單獨 adoption，反而透過 E7 SKU 會加速 adoption【KB:20260316_Wells_Fargo_MSFT_MSFT-_Agentic_Adoption_Hinges_on_Security-_E7_SKU_Presen.txt】。  
3. **Security Copilot agents 嘅作用**：Security 領域新增咗十幾個 security Copilot agents，例如 Icertis' SOC team 使用後將 manual triage time 減少 75%，解決咗行業人才短缺問題，助力 agentic adoption【KB:Microsoft_Corp_Earnings_Call_2026128_RT000000003094331726.pdf.txt】。  
4. **Security 成為 essential**：安全解決方案對管理組織 AI 部署變得 essential，而 E7 bundle 可能包含相關安全功能，從而促進 adoption【KB:Microsoft_Corp_Earnings_Call_2026128_RT000000003094331726.pdf.txt】。
